title: A kinder Gale
notes: The Updraft is on your side: the air draws every drop toward the groove and holds it up a little longer. Gusts keeps half that help.
The perfect-moment cue stays the whole sky on the first three Gale skies, and to floor 12 on the rest. Timing, not guessing.
Gentler carry, four seconds of calm between gusts, a slower Dark across the world. A wind-true widens the next drop by half.
